desc.spear.enchanted: [Debug] If the dash does not work, right-click while sneaking to reset the timers.
desc.spear.unenchanted: Holding right-click allows the Envinium Spear to parry attacks, knocking entities back and giving the user an attack buff. \n Attacking in a certain time frame will increase the damage by 50%.
effect.rinvenium.sparked.desc: Deals low damage rapidly and can chain to nearby players if they are wet.
effect.rinvenium.sparked_with_cooldown.d: Deals low damage in short intervals.
effect.rinvenium.swiss_cheese.desc: Applies a visually impairing overlay of holes.
enchantment.rinvenium.rush.desc:
The Envinium Spear will charge over time, 
allowing the user to rush forward at great speeds on right-click.
item.rinvenium.aurio_ingot.desc: Obtained by [R-Click] a Superheated Aurio Ingot on a water cauldron or source block.
item.rinvenium.envinia_ingot.desc: Obtained by [R-Click] a Superheated Envinia Ingot on a water cauldron or source block.
item.rinvenium.envixius_ingot.desc: Obtained by [R-Click] a Superheated Envixius Ingot on a water cauldron or source block.
item.rinvenium.envixius_plate.desc: Obtained by [R-Click] a Superheated Envixius Plate on a water cauldron or source block.

item.rinvenium.hail_of_the_gods.desc:
A minigun that goes brrrrtttt. 
 
 Starts with high spread, that slowly becomes more accurate. Be careful though, this weapon is prone to overheating. 
 After overheating, it enters a shotgun mode. If you let it heat up even more, things may go boom...
item.rinvenium.ion_cell.desc: Obtained by dropping a battery on a powered beacon.
item.rinvenium.superheated_aurio_ingot.d: Obtained by dropping a Gold Ingot and Copper Ingot into an empty cauldron above a soul flame.
item.rinvenium.superheated_envinia_ingot: Obtained by dropping a Netherite Scrap and Iron Ingot into an empty cauldron above a soul flame.
item.rinvenium.superheated_envixius_ingo: Obtained by dropping an Envinia Ingot and Aurio Ingot into an empty cauldron above a soul flame.
item.rinvenium.superheated_envixius_plat: Obtained by having an anvil fall on Superheated Envixius Ingot.
sound.rinvenium.hail_of_the_gods.shoot: Hail of the Gods goes BRRRTT
